title: ZDM: Operator Feedback (CMP-12)
description: Operator verdicts on model predictions from the feedback interface (platform data stock): disagreement by model version, used as labels by the training job.

panels.title: Operator disagreement rate by model version
panels.description: Share of incorrect verdicts among the predictions judged correct or incorrect (latest verdict of each prediction).

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (site_id, prediction_source_id, prediction_time)
         site_id, prediction_source_id, prediction_time, model_version, verdict, created_at
    FROM operator_feedback
   ORDER BY site_id, prediction_source_id, prediction_time, created_at DESC)
SELECT model_version,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'incorrect') AS incorrect,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'correct') AS correct,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'uncertain') AS uncertain,
       round((count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'incorrect'))::numeric
             / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict <> 'uncertain'), 0), 4) AS disagreement_rate
  FROM latest
 GROUP BY model_version ORDER BY model_version::int DESC

panels.title: Verdicts over time
panels.description: All verdicts recorded, including superseded ones.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', created_at) AS time, verdict AS metric, count(*) AS value
  FROM operator_feedback WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (site_id, prediction_source_id, prediction_time)
         site_id, prediction_source_id, prediction_time, model_version, verdict, created_at
    FROM operator_feedback
   ORDER BY site_id, prediction_source_id, prediction_time, created_at DESC)
SELECT count(*) AS reviewed FROM latest
SELECT count(*) AS corrected FROM operator_feedback WHERE corrected_label IS NOT NULL

SELECT created_at, operator, machine_id, model_version, predicted_label, verdict, corrected_label, comment
  FROM operator_feedback ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20
